snippet.title: Tiny Dangerous Dungeons Remake - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Tiny Dangerous Dungeons Remake on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179810/Tiny_Dangerous_Dungeons_Remake/

Classic mini metroidvania Tiny Dangerous Dungeons returns in a completely rebuilt adventure! Guide Timmy the little treasure hunter through a new,  twice as large dungeon than in the original game! Discover new puzzles, new items, new secrets, and battle ferocious new bosses!
